Stream Real-Time Events from a Philips Hue Bridge (SSE)

Source: R/eventstream.R
hue_eventstream.Rd

Opens a persistent Server-Sent Events (text/event-stream) connection to GET /eventstream/clip/v2 on a Philips Hue Bridge v2 or Bridge Pro and collects or processes real-time resource change events (including light state changes, button presses, sensor readings, and Bridge Pro MotionAware updates).

Usage

hue_eventstream(
  callback = NULL,
  max_events = 10L,
  timeout = 30,
  bridge = NULL,
  tidy = TRUE
)

Arguments

callback

Optional function invoked for each received SSE event. It receives a single argument: the parsed event object (tibble when tidy = TRUE, or a parsed list when tidy = FALSE). Return FALSE from callback to stop streaming early.

max_events

Positive integer scalar. Maximum number of SSE events to read before closing the connection. Defaults to 10L.

timeout

Numeric scalar. Total streaming timeout in seconds. Defaults to 30.

bridge

Optional hue_bridge object created by hue_bridge(). If NULL, resolves from session defaults set by hue_auth() or environment variables.

tidy

Logical scalar. If TRUE (default), parses each event's JSON data payload into a tibble with jsonlite. If FALSE, returns raw parsed lists.

Value

A list of parsed event objects (invisibly if callback is provided).

See also

hue_get_resources(), hue_bridge()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Collect up to 5 real-time bridge events
events <- hue_eventstream(max_events = 5L, timeout = 15)

# Process events live with a callback
hue_eventstream(
  callback = function(ev) {
    print(ev)
    TRUE
  },
  max_events = 20L
)
} # }
